verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented as letting users troubleshoot issues in plain language, and AI insights summarize workload health and potential issues. That is an AI-assisted investigation capability, but no evidence shows the AI investigating a specific alert or error and proposing a probable root cause. The CVE triage agent covers vulnerabilities, a different story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented alert/error-triggered AI investigation, explicit probable-root-cause output, depth of correlation across traces/logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
AI insights provide AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues.
